summary: Computes the distance from the predicted vehicle body position to the wheel-contact reference and writes a 13-element contact array into the network packet. When the wheel-contact reference argument a2 is provided, the predicted body position is advanced by a2 scaled by 0.025 (flt_59E87C); otherwise the stored body position is used unchanged. The delta to the current body position is rotated into the vehicle local frame by the 3x3 rotation matrix at this+0x34B0..0x34D0, offset by the local contact anchor at this+0x72C..0x734, and the resulting local contact point is passed for each of the 13 elements to NetworkPacketDataWriter (0x0054FA00). Returns the norm of the local contact vector, clamped to the minimum wheel-contact distance stored at this[3803]. On the per-frame path; called from the switch-based state handler (0x0040F380), AI racing-line follower (0x004E9CA0) and particle-effect update dispatch (0x004EB430).

operations.description: Read the three predicted-body-position components from this[3800..3802] (offsets 0x3B60/0x3B64/0x3B68) into locals.
When the wheel-contact reference a2 is non-null, add a2 scaled by 0.025 (flt_59E87C) to each predicted body-position component; otherwise keep the stored position.
Compute the delta between the predicted body position and the current body position stored at this[3381..3383] (offsets 0x34D4/0x34D8/0x34DC).
Rotate the position delta into the vehicle local frame by multiplying with the 3x3 rotation matrix at this+0x34B0..0x34D0 (row/column elements this[3372..3380]).
Subtract the local contact anchor this[459..461] (offsets 0x72C/0x730/0x734) from the rotated components to obtain the local-frame contact point.

For each of the 13 contact elements, read the stored contact position from the contact data array starting at this+0x3ABC (this[3759..3760] area), subtract the local contact anchor, and hand the element and its index to NetworkPacketDataWriter (0x0054FA00).
Compute the result as sqrt(localX^2 + localY^2 + localZ^2) over the un-anchored rotated components (v11/v13/v15).
Clamp: when the stored minimum wheel-contact distance this[3803] (offset 0x3B6C) is larger than the computed norm, return the stored value instead.
Return the computed norm, or the clamped stored distance when it is larger.

clean_pseudocode: px = this[3800]; py = this[3801]; pz = this[3802];
dx = px - this[3381]; dy = py - this[3382]; dz = pz - this[3383];
lx = dz * this[3378] + dy * this[3375] + dx * this[3372];
ly = dz * this[3379] + dy * this[3376] + dx * this[3373];
lz = dz * this[3380] + dy * this[3377] + dx * this[3374];
local[0] = lx - this[459]; local[1] = ly - this[460]; local[2] = lz - this[461];
